title: Add client sidebar state and config surface
description: Add client-level sidebar state, configuration flags, and selection bookkeeping so sidebar presence is tracked independently of pane modes. This is the base state layer for all later rendering and input work.

title: Native sidebar MVP
description: Deliver the first native sidebar MVP for kmux. The goal is a persistent left sidebar for session/workspace navigation while keeping the right side as native tmux with original performance, input handling, status bar, windows, and panes.

title: Route sidebar keyboard and mouse input in server client
description: Route keyboard and mouse input to the sidebar when it has focus or is hit-tested, without regressing normal tmux behavior on the right-hand native pane area.

title: Render native sidebar region in client redraw
description: Extend client redraw to reserve a fixed left sidebar region and render the session/workspace list there while leaving the right side as the existing tmux pane area.

title: Reuse window tree and mode tree for sidebar data model
description: Reuse tmux window-tree and mode-tree data and interaction semantics for the sidebar model, instead of inventing a parallel tree implementation.
